# scripts/

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by doc-sync. Edit Purpose and Key Patterns freely — they are preserved on update. -->

## Purpose

Autonomous documentation maintenance pipeline. `init-docs.py` bootstraps per-directory CLAUDE.md files once; `doc-audit.py` is called by the PostToolUse hook after every source file edit to detect drift and auto-commit updates.

## Files

- `doc-audit.py`: Drift detection + auto-update — finds nearest CLAUDE.md, extracts public surface via AST, detects staleness, calls `claude -p` to update, git-commits result
- `init-docs.py`: One-time bootstrapper — walks repo, creates CLAUDE.md for any dir with 2+ source files that doesn't already have one

## Key Patterns

- `doc-audit.py` is invoked by `.claude/hooks/doc-sync.sh` with the changed file path as argv[1]
- Staleness heuristic: if fewer than 50% of public symbol names appear in the doc, flag as stale
- AST parsing (`ast` stdlib) for Python; regex fallback for other languages
- 5-minute debounce per directory (stamp files in `.claude/`) prevents LLM call storms
- Auto-commit message format: `docs: auto-sync {source_file} → {doc_file}`

## Dependencies

- `claude` CLI must be on PATH (used via `subprocess` in `doc-audit.py`)
- `git` on PATH for repo root detection and auto-commit
- No pip packages beyond stdlib

## Notes

- Run `init-docs.py` once after cloning; subsequent updates are handled automatically by the hook
- Edit `## Purpose` and `## Key Patterns` sections in generated CLAUDE.mds freely — the auditor preserves them
- Hook is async (`async: true` in settings.json) — never blocks Claude Code
- Log file: `.claude/doc-sync.log`
